name: Qwen2-7B-Instruct
headline: State-of-the-art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks.
description: The Qwen2-7B-Instruct is a state-of-the-art multilingual language model with 7.07 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

technical_details.string_value: Prompt Processor and Token Generator are split into 5 parts each. Each corresponding Prompt Processor and Token Generator part share weights.

technical_details.key: Input sequence length for Prompt Processor

technical_details.string_value: Rate of response generation after the first response token.

English, Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Czech, Polish, Arabic, Persian, Hebrew, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Lao, Burmese, Cebuano, Khmer, Tagalog, Hindi, Bengali, Urdu.

Time To First Token is the time it takes to generate the first response token. This is expressed as a range because it varies based on the length of the prompt. The lower bound is for a short prompt (up to 128 tokens, i.e., one iteration of the prompt processor) and the upper bound is for a prompt using the full context length (4096 tokens).
